+package mssql
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql/driver"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// Mock driver that always fails to connect
+type mockFailingDriver struct{}
+
+func (d *mockFailingDriver) connect(ctx context.Context, c *Connector, params msdsn.Config) (*Conn, error) {
+	// Simulate a failed connection that returns (nil, error)
+	return nil, driver.ErrBadConn
+}
+
+func TestConnectorConnectWithNilConnection(t *testing.T) {
+	// Create a connector with a failing driver
+	connector := &Connector{
+		driver: &mockFailingDriver{},
+	}
+	
+	// This should not panic even though connect returns (nil, error)
+	_, err := connector.Connect(context.Background())
+	
+	// We expect an error, but not a panic
+	if err == nil {
+		t.Error("Expected an error but got none")
+	}
+}

+package mssql
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql/driver"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+// Mock driver that always fails to connect
+type mockFailingDriver struct{}
+
+func (d *mockFailingDriver) connect(ctx context.Context, c *Connector, params msdsn.Config) (*Conn, error) {
+	// Simulate a failed connection that returns (nil, error)
+	return nil, driver.ErrBadConn
+}
+
+func TestConnectorConnectWithNilConnection(t *testing.T) {
+	// Create a connector with a failing driver
+	connector := &Connector{
+		driver: &mockFailingDriver{},
+	}
+	
+	// This should not panic even though connect returns (nil, error)
+	_, err := connector.Connect(context.Background())
+	
+	// We expect an error, but not a panic
+	if err == nil {
+		t.Error("Expected an error but got none")
+	}
+}
